title: Tech Support: Intel Thunderbolt Overview
description: An introduction to Intel Thunderbolt available on the new MacBook Pros.

asr.full_text: Hello, and welcome to the Knowledge Bar. I'm Jerry. I'm going to be your knowledge expert on a new technology that's just come out, Thunderbolt. Alright, this does not mean a electroshock hazard. It means an exciting new, Intel-created I-O technology, capable of a ten gigabit per second transfer rate, bidirectional, including PCIe+, DisplayPort High Definition Audio and video. This group of technology is currently being showcased and released in the new Apple MacBook Pro line that just came out out of this year. What we get is the capability of being able to hook up with a single cable and a Daisy chain effect up to seven devices, both IO devices, and up to two different monitors. So, we have a single cable, leaving from the MacBook Pro, into a external hard drive. Let's see is now coming out with a new Thunderbolt capable external hard drive. And then, from there, daisy chain like you did with Firewire or if you remember the old scuzzy chain equipment, onto six additional devices, two of which can be monitors. This is some really cool stuff folks. Again, ten Gbps bi-directional. USB 3.0 is only five and USB 3.0 being host based never made that kind of speed. Now USb 3.0 has a huge advantage in that it s backwards compatible to a gazillion USB devices. But this is going to be a lot of fun to watch folks and see how this this shakes out Once again Apple has taken the initiative and come out with something new and cool and it's going to be a lot of fun to watch and thank you for watching today
